trials.claim: Lifetime deal for one-time payment of $59 with unlimited tokens
trials.claimQuote: Yes, nichesss offers a lifetime deal for a one-time payment of $59, which includes unlimited tokens, AI marketing copy generation, AI idea generation, and more.
trials.reasoning: E1 reports a 1000-generation limit and E2 reports needing an upgrade for article tools, directly conflicting with unlimited tokens included for one payment.

exhibits.quote: Happen to login today to just look around and saw a limit of 1000 generations for documents.
exhibits.argument: A 1000-generation limit directly contradicts the promise of unlimited tokens.

exhibits.quote: To use our AI powered ✨ article generation tools, like our chrome extension, you need to upgrade your account.
exhibits.argument: Requiring a paid upgrade undermines the claim that a one-time payment includes everything.

exhibits.quote: I purchased Nichesss in 2021, I got the LTD and of course have used it quite a bit since then.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms purchasing Nichesss as an LTD in 2021 and continuing to use it.

exhibits.quote: With unlimited tokens at your disposal, Nichesss allows you to generate high-quality content without the constraints of traditional writing tools.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms Nichesss provides unlimited tokens for generating content.

trials.claim: Offers 60-day money-back guarantee to try the platform for two months
trials.claimQuote: Yes, nichesss offers a 60-day money-back guarantee, allowing users to try the platform for two months to ensure it meets their needs.
trials.reasoning: E3 and E4 only express uncertainty or a wish for a refund, without showing purchase timing, a refund request, or denial within 60 days, and no guarantee terms are shown.

exhibits.quote: Waiting for the refund (maybe it's too late to get the refund, whatever!).
exhibits.argument: Buyer uncertainty about getting a refund undermines the promise of an easy 60-day money-back guarantee.

exhibits.quote: I wish I could get my money back or maybe I'll just donate it to someone else.
exhibits.argument: Buyer feeling unable to get money back contradicts the claim of a money-back guarantee.

trials.claim: Support via email at help@nichesss.com or help page

exhibits.quote: For a simple question sent to their support box: help@nichesss.com, I waited 4 days with no response.
exhibits.argument: Four days with no response to the listed support email undermines the support claim.

exhibits.quote: But there was no follow up what so ever and our issue was simply forgotten.
exhibits.argument: Reported lack of follow-up after contacting support contradicts effective email support.
